idea-plugin.name: DocScribe
idea-plugin.description:
Auto-generate inline YARD documentation for Ruby methods using docscribe.

Features

  • Check Ruby files for missing YARD documentation
  • Apply safe fixes (add required tags)
  • Apply aggressive fixes (add full documentation)
  • Inline diagnostics on file open and save
  • Collapsible YARD comment blocks
  • RBS type inference
  • Rake file support

Compatible with docscribe >= 1.5.0.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.7

Added

  • RBS-aware inspections — check, safe/aggressive fix and workspace check auto-detect RBS via RbsDetector and forward --rbs / --rbs-collection via cli_overrides
  • Doctor RBS status — DocScribe Doctor shows sig/, rbs gem, rbs_collection.lock.yaml and rbs.enabled
  • Annotator cache invalidation on RBS changes — configHash includes rbsHash
  • MCP API — DocScribeMcpToolset exposing 6 tools (docscribe_check_file, docscribe_check_workspace, docscribe_safe_fix, docscribe_aggressive_fix, docscribe_update_types, docscribe_doctor)
  • i18n — English and Russian localizations via DocScribeBundle
  • Invalid YARD type validation — warnOnInvalidYardTypes setting forwarded as --validate-types
  • File-scoped Update Types — refresh YARD docs from RBS signatures for current file
  • Fix routing by source — rbs | infer | syntax

Fixed

  • RBS mismatch underlines YARD line, not def
  • Safe fix UX for RBS — routes through aggressive fix
  • update_types exit code 1 and daemon fallback on -32601 for old daemons
  • Doctor stale version cache — invalidated on Gemfile.lock mtime
  • MCP toolset not loading — registered via withMcpServer.xml
  • Errors shown as balloon with “Add to Gemfile” instead of red squiggle
  • collectRubyFiles synced with CLI filter

Changed

  • Version bumped from 0.1.6 to 0.1.7
  • Requires docscribe >= 1.6.2 for new API

0.1.6

Added

  • Batch workspace check — all .rb / .rake / Rakefile files sent in one check_batch RPC call
  • check_batch RPC support in DocscribeDaemon — per-file errors reported independently, requires docscribe >= 1.5.2
  • Batch capability detection — batchMode for version >= 1.5.2 alongside serverMode

Changed

  • Version bumped from 0.1.5 to 0.1.6
  • Workspace check runs in chunks of 10 with progress and cancellation support
  • Target IDE widened to 2026.1 — 2026.2
  • Notification group registration hardened — registry fallback

Fixed

  • Workspace check silently no-ops in server mode — now enumerates files and uses batch endpoint
  • Gem check used system Ruby instead of module SDK bundle path — now runs SDK bundle by absolute path

0.1.5

Added

  • Doctor diagnostics action — menu entry showing Ruby SDK, Gemfile, docscribe gem, daemon state, settings
  • Rakefile support (no extension) — all actions and annotations work on Rakefile files
  • Capability detection — docscribe version parsed on startup; server mode skipped for < 1.5.1
  • Graceful handling when docscribe gem not installed — notification with “Open Gemfile” action

Changed

  • com.intellij.modules.ruby made optional — plugin installs on IntelliJ IDEA (limited), unblocks Marketplace
  • All commands use project Ruby SDK — SDK bin/ on PATH, BUNDLE_GEMFILE set
  • Concurrency guard for rapid annotations — per-file generation discards stale results
  • Annotation cache respects settings — configHash derived from hideCommentsByDefault
  • Version bumped from 0.1.4 to 0.1.5

Fixed

  • Annotation cache not invalidated on settings change — added clear on save

Build

  • intellijDependencies() added to repository section in build.gradle.kts

0.1.4

Fixed

  • RPC protocol deadlock — JSON-RPC requests now include trailing newline and EOF signal
  • Exit code semantics — all fix actions check exitCode != 0 instead of >= 2
  • VFS refresh in intention actions — ensures external file changes are detected
  • Folding builder never loaded — language="Ruby" → language="ruby"
  • Folding regions silently dropped — added order="first"
  • CI test failures — added Ruby setup, docscribe gem, bundler-cache

Added

  • Daemon mode — persistent Ruby server over Unix socket JSON-RPC 2.0
  • hideCommentsByDefault reactivity — folding rebuilds on setting toggle
  • Full KDoc documentation on all 17 main source files
  • 45 new tests (117 total)

Changed

  • Removed 5 dead settings (commandPath, useBundleExec, runOnSave, useRbs, useDaemon)
  • Settings page reduced to a single checkbox
  • Always passes -B flag in safe/aggressive modes
  • Daemon always-on — no toggle
